comments.text: +MaTrIXxMA My reasoning was that it was my first build and I wanted it to be sustainable for a while since graphics cards are so expensive. I didn't want to invest in a really good 1440p monitor but then when games get more demanding, I can't play them at really good framerates maxed out at that resolution. And if I put the rez to 1080p to get better performance I heard it might look blurry on a native 1440p monitor. So I went with a really good deal on a 1080p 144hz Gsync 1ms monitor and now I'm playing all games  maxed out at really good framerates. lol
